name: 第七章 · 段落工坊
subtitle: 段落排序
goal: 把打乱的句子排成通顺的一段 —— 先找信号词，再理逻辑

levels.goal: 按时间先后排列一件事：先找时间词，时间词就是路标

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 先找时间词：at seven → after → on the way → and then

blocks.text: I got up at seven this morning.
After breakfast, I went to school.
On the way, I met an old friend.
We talked for a while and then said goodbye.

distractors.text: I usually go to bed at eleven.

rounds.explain: 按时间排的关键是找「时间词」：at seven → After breakfast → On the way → and then，这四个词本身就是路标。最后那句说晚上十一点睡觉，和早上出门这条时间线对不上。
rounds.example: 信号词：at seven / After… / On the way / and then
rounds.win: 时间词就是段落的路标。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 先说什么时候出发，再说到哪儿、做了什么

blocks.text: Last summer, my family went to the beach.
We left home early in the morning.
When we arrived, the sun was already high.
We swam and played until the evening.

distractors.text: My father does not like swimming at all.

rounds.explain: 叙事段落的常规写法：先交代时间地点（Last summer），再说出发，再说到达，最后说做了什么。最后那句说爸爸不喜欢游泳，和「我们游泳玩到晚上」直接矛盾，不能放进来。
rounds.example: Last summer → left home → arrived → swam and played
rounds.win: 时间线要顺，前后不能打架。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 休息 → 开始写 → 写了多久 → 之后做什么

blocks.text: I came home and had a short rest.
Then I started my homework.
It took me about two hours.
After that, I watched TV for a while.

distractors.text: I forgot to bring my book home.

rounds.explain: 短句之间用 Then / After that 串起来，时间线就清楚了。最后那句说「忘带书回家」——如果真忘了，后面根本做不了作业，所以它和整段冲突。
rounds.example: had a rest → Then started → took two hours → After that
rounds.win: 注意句子之间不能互相矛盾。

levels.goal: 观点 → 理由 → 例子 → 结论：中国学生最该练熟的段落骨架

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 先说观点，再说理由，然后举例，最后总结

blocks.text: Online learning has become very popular.
It is convenient because you can study anywhere.
For example, you can watch a lesson on the bus.
In conclusion, online learning saves a lot of time.

distractors.text: My brother is a teacher in a middle school.

rounds.explain: 这是最标准的英语段落骨架：主题句（观点）→ 理由 → 例子 → 结论。信号词也很明显：For example 一定跟在理由后面，In conclusion 一定在最后。最后那句讲哥哥是老师，和「在线学习」这个主题没有任何关系。
rounds.example: 观点 → 理由 → For example… → In conclusion…
rounds.win: 观点、理由、例子、结论，一段就这四块。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: First of all / Moreover 提示这两句是并列的理由

blocks.text: Reading is one of the best habits.
First of all, it builds your vocabulary.
Moreover, it helps you think more clearly.
To sum up, everyone should read every day.

rounds.explain: First of all 和 Moreover 是成对出现的：一个提第一点，一个补第二点，所以它们必须连着。To sum up 收尾。最后那句谈的是书价，这段谈的是阅读习惯，主题不搭。
rounds.example: 观点 → First of all… → Moreover… → To sum up…
rounds.win: First of all 和 Moreover 是成套的。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: Therefore 表示「因此」，只能用在结论句

blocks.text: Exercising every day is important.
It keeps your body strong.
It also makes you feel happier.
Therefore, we should exercise regularly.

distractors.text: I bought a new pair of shoes yesterday.

rounds.explain: 第二句和第三句是并列的两个好处，用 It also 衔接。Therefore 引出结论，必须放最后。买鞋那句虽然和运动沾边，但它是个人琐事，支撑不了观点。
rounds.example: 观点 → 理由一 → It also… → Therefore…

levels.goal: 起因 → 结果 → 接着 → 最后：让每一句都能接上上一句

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: As a result 前面一定是原因

blocks.text: The weather was terrible last weekend.
As a result, all the flights were canceled.
We had to stay at the airport for a whole night.
In the end, we took a train home.

distractors.text: The airport was very clean and modern.

rounds.explain: As a result 的信号很硬：它前面必须是原因（天气糟糕），后面才是结果（航班取消）。后面两句顺着「结果」往下推：先滞留，最后改坐火车。机场干净那句是无关细节。
rounds.example: 起因 → As a result… → 于是… → In the end…
rounds.win: As a result 前面永远跟着原因。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 考砸之后，人的反应、再之后做了什么

blocks.text: Tom did not study for the exam.
Therefore, he failed it.
His parents were very disappointed.
He promised to work harder next time.

distractors.text: The exam was held in a large hall.

rounds.explain: Therefore 说明第二句是第一句的结果；第三句是结果带来的反应；第四句是反应之后的行动。这样一环扣一环。考场大不大，对这条因果链没有任何影响。
rounds.example: 没有复习 → Therefore 挂了 → 父母失望 → 他下决心
rounds.win: 每一句都要能接上上一句。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 两句 As a result / Finally 把链条串起来

blocks.text: The city built a new subway line.
Therefore, many people gave up driving.
As a result, the air became much cleaner.
Finally, the city won an environmental prize.

distractors.text: The new line has twenty stations.

rounds.explain: 这一段的因果是层层推进的：修地铁 → 少开车 → 空气变好 → 得奖。两个连接词 Therefore 和 As a result 交替使用，避免重复。有几站是细节，插进来会把链条打断。
rounds.example: 修地铁 → Therefore → As a result → Finally
rounds.win: 因果可以一层一层往下推。

levels.goal: First / Then / Next / Finally：说明步骤时必须一个不差按顺序

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: First / Then / Next / Finally 已经把顺序写出来了

blocks.text: First, boil some water.
Then, put a tea bag into the cup.
Next, pour the hot water into the cup.
Finally, wait for three minutes and enjoy it.

distractors.text: Tea is very popular in many countries.

rounds.explain: 说明步骤时，First / Then / Next / Finally 就是顺序本身，照着排就行。最后那句是背景介绍，不是步骤，放进流程里会让读者以为也要做这件事。
rounds.win: 步骤段落里，不需要的话不要放。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 办卡 → 查书 → 记号码 → 找管理员求助

blocks.text: First, you need a library card.
Then, you can search for books on the computer.
After that, write down the book number.
Finally, ask the librarian if you cannot find it.

distractors.text: The library closes at nine on weekdays.

rounds.explain: 这四步是有先后依赖的：没有借书证就没法借，没查到书号就没法找书。闭馆时间是补充信息，放在步骤中间会打断动作顺序。
rounds.example: 办证 → Then 查书 → After that 记书号 → Finally 找人帮忙
rounds.win: 步骤之间有先后依赖，顺序不能换。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 写信的顺序：主题 → 问候 → 正文 → 结尾

blocks.text: First, write a clear subject line.
Then, greet the person politely.
After that, state your purpose in one or two sentences.
Finally, end with a polite closing.

distractors.text: Many people check their email every hour.

rounds.explain: 写邮件也有固定顺序：主题行 → 称呼 → 说明来意 → 结尾。把这四句排对，就等于掌握了一封邮件的基本骨架。
rounds.example: subject line → greet → state your purpose → closing
rounds.win: 流程段落练熟了，写说明文就有谱了。

levels.goal: 一方面 / 另一方面 / 权衡：让步转折的段落怎么搭

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: On the one hand 和 On the other hand 是成套的

blocks.text: Living in a city has both advantages and disadvantages.
On the one hand, it offers more job opportunities.
On the other hand, the cost of living is much higher.
In conclusion, it depends on what you value most.

distractors.text: My uncle has lived in the same city for thirty years.

rounds.explain: 主题句里说了「既有优点也有缺点」，后面就必须一段好处、一段坏处。On the one hand 和 On the other hand 是成套的，顺序固定。结论不能偏袒一边，所以用 it depends。
rounds.example: 主题 → On the one hand… → On the other hand… → In conclusion…
rounds.win: 说了两面，就得两面都写。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 先立论，再转折，最后给折中结论

blocks.text: Some people prefer to work from home.
They say it saves both time and money.
However, others find it hard to stay focused at home.
Therefore, the best choice depends on the person.

distractors.text: The company moved to a new office last year.

rounds.explain: 这一段的结构是「立论 → 转折 → 折中」：先给一方的理由，再用 However 引出反方，最后用 Therefore 给出平衡的结论。这也是议论文最常见的骨架。
rounds.example: 正面理由 → However 反方 → Therefore 折中
rounds.win: However 一出现，段落就转到对面去了。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 两个「一方面」用不同的说法，避免重复

blocks.text: Both paper books and e-books have their fans.
Paper books are easier on the eyes.
E-books, on the other hand, are lighter to carry.
In the end, it is a matter of personal taste.

distractors.text: I read three books last month.

rounds.explain: 对比段落里，两边要讲同一类事情才公平：这里一边讲「看着舒服」，一边讲「带着轻便」，都是使用感受。结论用 it is a matter of personal taste 收尾，不下死判断。
rounds.example: 主题 → 纸质书 → on the other hand 电子书 → In the end…
rounds.win: 对比要讲同一类事，才叫对比。

levels.goal: 时间、总分总、因果三种段落混着来 —— 限时挑战

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话

blocks.text: Last Friday, our class went on a school trip.
We set off at six in the morning.
After two hours, we reached the mountain.
We climbed to the top and took many photos.
In the evening, we came back home, tired but happy.

distractors.text: Our teacher is very strict with us.

rounds.explain: 五句叙事：Last Friday 交代时间，然后 set off → reached → climbed → came back，一条时间线走到底。In the evening 和开头的 Last Friday 首尾呼应。老师严不严，跟这次出游没关系。
rounds.example: Last Friday → set off → reached → climbed → In the evening
rounds.win: 五句话也能排得严丝合缝。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 总分总：观点 + 两个理由 + 例子 + 结论

blocks.text: Learning a foreign language is good for you.
First, it opens the door to other cultures.
Moreover, it makes your brain work better.
For example, studies show it can improve memory.
In conclusion, everyone should learn at least one foreign language.

rounds.explain: 标准的总分总：观点 → First 理由一 → Moreover 理由二 → For example 例子 → In conclusion 结论。四个信号词把一个段落切得清清楚楚。cousin 会三门语言是个人例子，撑不起全段的结论。
rounds.example: 观点 → First → Moreover → For example → In conclusion
rounds.win: 信号词齐了，段落结构自己就浮出来了。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 这一段的因果有点绕：先说结果，再倒回去讲原因

blocks.text: The small shop closed last month.
The rent had gone up twice in one year.
As a result, the owner could not make any profit.
Finally, he decided to move to another street.

distractors.text: The shop used to sell fresh vegetables.

rounds.explain: 这一段先抛结果（店关了），再回头讲原因（房租涨了两次），然后顺着往下说（赚不到钱 → 搬走）。先果后因是写作里常见的写法，读起来更抓人。蔬菜那句是背景，会把因果链岔开。
rounds.example: 先说结果 → 倒回原因 → As a result → Finally
rounds.win: 因果不一定是先因后果，也可以先抛结果。
